propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking diagnostic to verify mapped-key and legacy_default visibility to the bot outside a full reconcile pass.

The new `--live-visibility` flag on `rebar bridge fsck` must reuse the shared helper from ticket D (`check_mapped_project_visibility`) and emit advisory results to stderr without mutating bridge state or changing exit codes.
When Jira credentials are absent or incomplete and no probe is injected, the fsck step must gracefully skip with an advisory verdict rather than fail.
Core `rebar doctor` must remain Jira-free with no new reconciler or agents optional-extra imports reachable from `_commands/doctor.py`.
The default `rebar bridge fsck` stdout JSON schema contract must remain unchanged (`unknown_event_types`, `binding_drift`, `store_integrity` only) regardless of the `--live-visibility` flag.
